_comment: THE model-family table (operator rule 2026-10-31): one source of truth.
A reviewer and an author must ALWAYS come from different families, so the
family of every roster model has to be answered in exactly one place.
Order inside a pattern list does not matter: the LONGEST matching pattern
wins, so 'gemma4' never shadows a more specific 'gemma4-31b' entry.
An unknown model is its own family ('model:<lower-cased id>') and matches
nothing but itself -- fail closed, never a guessed family.
